value.message: Town of Oakville runs Preschool A swim, ages 3-5, Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, their site says - price is set by Council in the Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Tue Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I could not tie a price to it yet, so I'll keep watching and text you when it's posted.
